args.title: Fix password reset email linking to localhost in production
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever process.env.PUBLIC_URL is not set, and this fallback is being used to build the password reset link (and other links such as the rollup and export emails). This means that in production, if PUBLIC_URL isn't configured in the environment, users receive emails pointing at localhost instead of the real site.

Proposed fix: ensure PUBLIC_URL is set in the production environment/deployment configuration, and/or make the code fail loudly (e.g., throw or log an error at startup) when PUBLIC_URL is missing in a non-development environment, rather than silently falling back to localhost. This prevents the reset-password link (and other BASE_URL-derived links) from silently defaulting to an unreachable localhost URL after deploys.
